styleLock.direction: clean-air home appliance ecommerce, cool tech base with one warm accent
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF packshot sweep for product-only screens; solid #3E6CB5 and #2C4E8A brand panels for infographic screens; soft #EEF1F5 to #E4E7EB vertical gradients for grid and spec screens; light #D7E3EE room tones for lifestyle scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio lighting with a front-left key at 5500K, gentle fill, soft contact shadows and one controlled edge highlight running down the product shell; night scene drops to a low warm 3000K ambient with a soft glow band and a light pool on the surface
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte #FFFFFF lacquer tabletop, light grey #E9EDF2 matte board, warm sand #E9DCCB side table and #D9E2EC floor tile, all read as matte with a soft grounded contact shadow
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for headline and label typesetting only, headline 28-48pt in #22303F or #FFFFFF, labels 10-14pt, numeric spec figures oversized and light-weight, no serif, handwritten or display faces
styleLock.iconSystem: consistent thin-line circular icons at 1.5px stroke, single warm accent #E8834F on brand panels, plus thin leader lines and small numbered circles, no filled, 3D or skeuomorphic icons
styleLock.presentationRules: the tall upright product stays upright, centered or on a stable third, at a repeatable scale across the set; hero angles are a slight 3/4 front or a straight-on front; never tilted, never rotated, never cropped by the frame edge; a soft contact shadow always grounds the base
noDrift: no product redesign or proportion change
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean-air home appliance e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of #FFFFFF packshot sweep, #EEF1F5 light mist base, #3E6CB5 brand panel, #2C4E8A deep brand panel, charcoal text #22303F and one warm accent #E8834F; cool tone with a single warm accent; soft diffused studio lighting with a front-left key at 5500K, gentle fill, soft contact shadows and one controlled edge highlight along the product shell; one modern geometric sans-serif for headline and label typesetting only; consistent rounded info labels, thin leader lines and small numbered circles; consistent thin-line icon style at 1.5px stroke; clean high-end appliance photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; product always upright and stable in scale with a grounding contact shadow, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no product redesign.

provenance.notes: 从 11 屏爆款加湿器详情页长图切片提炼。已剥离：原图中文文案与独特标题排版、原店铺会员角标与二维码、原图品牌/型号信息、原图数值规格（容量/续航/温度/净化类宣称）与专利描述，全部改写为 「」+ {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 文案槽位由使用方填写真实内容，不发明任何认证与数据；产品一律以 {product} 占位，构图/机位/光位/背景/配色作为可复用视觉语法保留。机身形态按通用几何（立式圆角柱体）描述，不绑定源商品。
